name: Gold Hill Ruins
title: Gold Hill Ruins
summary: A mesa-top Empyrean ruin at 21.2N 12.6W, on an unclimbable mountain 100-150 m above the plains (z 240). It has an avenue of obelisks, pillars and broken columns ending between twin 6 m towers, 10 m ruined walls topped with candles, portal-stone floor tiles, a gold-and-blue frame with candles, and a mossy brick hearth holding the Smoldering Brazier and the Runed Chest. Pines grow among the ruins, and Sclavus have made it their base.

shots.standingOrder: Climb clockwise from east to south-east round the mossy brick hearth where the Smoldering Brazier burns, 24 to 42 m out and over the mesa's canopy, until the Gold Hill ruins and the plains 150 m below open up; keep 24 m from every crown.
shots.notes: Helix with flame. The camera climbs clockwise from east to south-east round the mossy brick hearth where the Smoldering Brazier burns, from 24 m to 42 m out and from 36 m to 60 m up, looking down into the hearth. It rises over the mesa's canopy (crowns at 24 m or more) until the obelisks, the ruined walls and the plains 150 m below open up. The late-morning sun shines from behind.
